engineNeeds.sketch: WallRun{poly, face, topLiftPx, baseLiftPx, style:'ashlar'|'quay'|'strata', openings?, parapet?}; 6-tile chunk bakes with a shared course grid (seams on course joints, split at openings), sliced back to per-tile 64px frames at the engine's own z; corner quoin chunks; curved-polyline support; extends the stoneF painter (IslandMapIso.tsx ~2229-2248)
ParapetTile{tx,ty,dir,hPx:14-18,cap,merlons?}; back face (tint ~0.85) + front face + 1px lit cap; lip stays walkable with EDGEBLOCK(tile+dir) in the registry (today only whole-tile PROPBLOCK exists)

(a) openings painted into the WallRun bake (voussoir ring, vertical near-black gradient), zero runtime masking; (b) registry walkLift separate from visualTopLift; walker reads walkLift, sprite z uses the walkLift band; the hardest new mechanic

stairRun(from,dir,width,topPx,basePx,treadPx=7): per-tile lerped lifts quantized to tread multiples; baked 64x32 tread-diamond family (1px lit lip / 1px dark riser per tread, slabVariant palette); riser strips cropped from the wall bake; balustrade crowns ride the lerp

drum(cx,cy,r,topPx,batter=1.15): walkable top tiles + ONE baked battered-ellipse canvas with radial curved coursing and wet line, placed as a single engine-generated sprite at the front-row z; collision and the walkable socket remain real tiles (engine construct, not a pasted PNG)

Map<ty*COLS+tx, {lift, walkLift?, walk, mat, edgeBlock?}>; every construct emits into it after init; render/walk/prop/vegetation/audit all read it; island-audit flood-fills over it to prove both walk chains as data on every load

order cliff-coast tiles into runs by neighbor-walking, bake one long strata canvas per run (diagonal bands at one consistent angle: orange #e08a3c-family lit, purple #5a2d4a-family shadow, green lip fringe), frame-crop per tile at x=s*64; scree boulders in PROPBLOCK

rules: parameterize volcano.ts by config; hub keeps its constants; hRim computed from THIS config (never /92)
clip at the citadel: cone levels only outside terrace/quay/built polygons; toe within 0-1 tiles of the terrace back edge (R15)
excise by config, never deletion: heads.ts merge, MOUTH/TONGUE/plaza, crater lava lake (craterK>0.32 OFF, R12), coast LAVA lines, quench dressing
lava = 4-5 short upper-flank rivulet polylines rim -> band frontier (R13); flipbook + vein machinery with shorter paths
crown asserts after LV build: >=4 tiles at max level, connected >=2-tile crater floor, no tile above rim

glitch pass: (a) back-edge void fill for ALL cone tiles drop>=2 tinted from coneTint; (b) drawFace skin by blended vBelt (no riser flips); (c) verify sideL family loads; (d) steam plume re-anchored at argmax-rim tile, ~60% scale, drifts screen-right
run SPIKE/DIP killers on cone rings (hub skip no longer holds at this radius)
retune radii proportionally: shadow wedge ~(0.4R, 1.8R) = (8,36) at R20; prop rejection lavaDist<1.5; sun azimuth 2.85 unchanged
verdictChecks: straighter stratocone silhouette with flaring toe
hunt at 2x: riser-color flips, black back-edge slivers, bright tread crescents
